# harvester_kubeovn_vpc_nat_gateway (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harvester_kubeovn_vpc_nat_gateway" "example" {
  name = "my-nat-gateway"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `external_subnets` (List of String) Names of the external subnets of the gateway. kube-ovn attaches the gateway to the first one only and ignores the others; changing the first one rebuilds the gateway pod on that network. It must be backed by a network attachment definition: on Harvester, a kube-ovn subnet whose network_provider is <network name>.<network namespace>.ovn. kube-ovn uses the subnet ovn-vpc-external-network when it is omitted.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `lan_ip` (String) Address of the gateway in subnet. It must be inside the subnet CIDR and free: the VPC routes its external traffic to it.
- `message` (String)
- `qos_policy` (String) Name of the kube-ovn QoS policy applied to the gateway.
- `selector` (List of String) Node selector of the gateway pod, as "key: value" entries.
- `state` (String)
- `status_external_subnets` (List of String) External subnets applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_qos_policy` (String) QoS policy applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_selector` (List of String) Node selector applied by kube-ovn.
- `subnet` (String) Name of the VPC subnet the gateway pod is attached to.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `vpc` (String) Name of the VPC the gateway serves.
